issues.claim: Binsky Home — 281 Centennial Ave, Suite C, Piscataway (HVAC/plumbing/electrical)
issues.problem: Wrong town/address. The company's own contact page lists its addresses as 22 Worlds Fair Drive, Suite E, Somerset NJ 08873 and 2000 Cabot Blvd W, Langhorne PA — no Piscataway location. 281 Centennial Ave appears to belong to Binsky & Snyder, the commercial mechanical arm, not the residential 'Binsky Home' entity in this list.
issues.fix: Either re-attribute the entry to Binsky & Snyder (commercial mechanical, Piscataway) or drop it; if kept, change address to Somerset and re-test against the zone's base-in-town rule.

issues.claim: Olympus Construction, LLC. — 54 Powers St, Piscataway, phone (732) 418-7111
issues.problem: Wrong town. 54 Powers St is in New Brunswick, NJ 08901 (BBB profile is filed under New Brunswick, and Olympus' own site is a New Jersey-wide construction company with no Piscataway address).
issues.fix: Remove from the Piscataway zone or move to the New Brunswick zone.

issues.problem: Wrong town. Talmadge Road is in Edison: BBB files the company at 180 Talmadge Road, Unit 447, Edison NJ 08817. The firm only lists Piscataway among towns it serves.

issues.claim: Greysi and Sons Solutions — general contractor, Piscataway
issues.problem: No Piscataway connection found. The only cited source (greysiandsons.com) says it works 'throughout New Jersey' and lists no address, no town and no Piscataway service page. The entry's town is unsupported.
issues.fix: Drop, or downgrade to 'NJ-wide, town unknown' until a Piscataway base or Piscataway-specific evidence is found.

issues.claim: Katamount Construction Company — 495 Union Ave, Suite 2C, Piscataway
issues.problem: Address unverified. katamountnj.com/contact shows no address at all, and directories (GAF contractor record, company site) place the firm in Middlesex rather than at 495 Union Ave. Only a Google Maps result asserted the Piscataway suite.
issues.fix: Verify 495 Union Ave directly (call/city permit record) or move the entry to the Middlesex zone; keep phone (908) 373-1244, which is confirmed.

issues.problem: Two entries look like branches of larger multi-location brands rather than Piscataway independents: 'Precision Painting Plus of Edison' (Precision Painting Plus runs at least six NJ offices, including a Piscataway office at 30 Knightsbridge Rd, and markets under one brand) and 'Sciens Building Solutions / Absolute Protective Systems' (its own page states it is 'part of the Sciens Building Solutions network', a multi-state fire/security platform). Both plausibly breach the chains/franchises exclusion.
issues.fix: Confirm ownership (franchise/company-owned/corporate branch) and drop both if they are brand branches; keep Absolute Protective Systems only if it is being targeted as the local operating brand with local decision-making.

issues.claim: Precision Painting Plus of Edison — 'Angi profile with 852 reviews'
issues.problem: Review volume/scale is consistent with a multi-crew regional brand, not the owner-operator profile the zone is being built for; the entry was already self-flagged 'may be a franchise-style operation'.
issues.fix: Treat as out-of-scope unless triage specifically wants multi-location brands; do not spend verification time on it before that decision.

issues.problem: Minor: the homepage never states the Piscataway address; the 480 Sidney Road address is only confirmed on GAF's contractor record and the company's Piscataway service-area page.
issues.fix: Cite the Piscataway service-area page (doubledconstructionnj.com/areas-we-serve/piscataway-nj/) instead of the kitchen/bath page as the primary source.

issues.problem: Minor street-suffix error: BBB gives 33 Crestwood Dr, Piscataway 08854 (and a phone of 732-748-9690, which the list omits). Town is correct.
issues.fix: Change 'St' to 'Dr'; add phone 732-748-9690 if still current.

issues.problem: Several Piscataway-based eligible businesses surfaced immediately in my own searches and are absent from the list (see coverage.missing), notably a Piscataway-offices commercial roofer and two tree-services with Piscataway offices.
issues.fix: Add the missing entries listed in coverage.missing; they add genuine local, owner-operated trade businesses that fit the zone.

data_gaps: Only ~32 of ~160 entries were opened or checked against a live page/search result; roughly 30 entries carry no street address and ~25 no phone, so those are guesses by the mapper and untested here.

BBB, Yellow Pages, Superpages, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BuildZoom and some company sites (alwayscomfy.com, backflownj.com, dailycleaningserv.com) returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; for those, evidence came from search results quoting the page, which is weaker than an opened page.

Olympus Construction's New Brunswick address was confirmed only from search-result data (BBB and company site); the BBB profile itself was blocked, so a 30-second call or city permit lookup should confirm it before deletion.

Birdeye, Porch, Thumbtack, CARFAX, Nextdoor and Procore profiles were not opened directly; entries resting on them (e.g. Vinci Plumbing, RAS Electric, FAME Construction, JRJ Fence, All Jersey Moving) remain unverified by me.

Lead-generation-style brand names (Piscataway Towing, Garage Door Repair Piscataway, Auto Glass & Windshield Replacement of Piscataway, Provision Garage Door Repair Piscataway, Piscataway Locksmith Corp) were not individually resolved to a real local owner; the mapper flagged them and I could neither confirm nor refute.
No NJ Division of Consumer Affairs license lookup was performed (interactive form), so home-improvement contractor registration status is unverified for every entry.
